Node组件→执行claim/fence→默认Pi模型/工具循环→sandbox.exec/结果/事件→heartbeat与恢复，许可依配置，见 [Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02)。
四材料身份/revision/作者摘要一致，catalog无旧研究。抽核Node组装/执行worker、core registry、当前Pi循环/assembly/tool adapter、代表bash和许可、生产sandbox选择。未全审所有API/云/ACP/子代理/Vault/数据库实现与租户/镜像供应链，不读真实.env，不部署/运行。
固定private根工程0.1.0，平台infra非DSH插件；多包/镜像有独立版本，不把根版本当当前托管服务或全组件版本。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Node24/控制面/DB/blob/实时事件 | 必需 | 会话和任务管理 | 必须满足存储/事务合同 |
| 模型/harness/凭据 | 必需 | 自主推理 | 不同API/模型能力不同 |
| sandbox供应商/镜像/网络 | 工具执行必需 | shell/文件/浏览器 | 生产不允test本地进程偷降级 |
| 权限/认证/租户隔离/运维 | 生产必需 | 许可/密钥/恢复 | 默认allow不等全审批 |

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 控制面/DB/模型/sandbox未知 | 镜像/认证/合同/权限配置 | 未部署最小组合 |
| 持续使用 | token/运行时/存储/网络未知 | 监控/升级/隔离/值守 | 自托管非自动便宜 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试/外部副作用未知 | 租约/事件/文件/对账 | 无故障恢复实测 |
| 退出 | 活跃执行/调度费用未知 | 停实例/导出/撤密钥 | 停Web不等停所有工作 |
先观察并准备单组合隔离测试任务与模拟外部服务，达到权限/恢复/退出对账再扩大，见 [Q03](#research-q03)。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 自主执行 | 默认Pi与真工具循环 | 新任务质量/兼容全覆盖 |
| 恢复 | claim/fence/heartbeat | 外部副作用无重复/遗漏 |
| 控制 | 权限配置/确认暂停 | 全租户隔离/运营净收益 |
[Q02](#research-q02) claim租约和确认适配的实际接线值得借鉴，默认Pi与legacy区分清楚；不可混淆状态持久/租约与业务幂等。
会话/执行环境/harness分层，真工具循环、领取续租和可配置确认成为托管执行基础，见 [Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02)。
持久租约非外部动作exactly-once；缺省许可可allow、确认/共享sandbox/凭据隔离依配置，API与云合同不同，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
动作ID/许可/后置证据连接租约、事件与检查点，接手先对账，测故障重复/遗漏和总成本，未实现，见 [Q03](#research-q03)。

recommendation.reason: 需要自行托管 Agent 会话、工具和恢复的团队可观察 OpenMA 的控制面与执行合同，并先准备一条最小隔离评估路径。当前默认 Pi 确有模型与工具继续循环，Node 也有领取续租和确认机制，但默认许可、沙箱和凭据隔离依配置，持久恢复不证明外部动作恰好执行一次。先固定 Node/Pi/模型/存储/sandbox 组合，用测试文件和模拟外部服务核权限、失租、对账与退出费用，收益不足时保留现有 harness 而不扩全平台。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 自托管控制/恢复场景50%，无真实团队重复需求不足75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 真租约/确认/组装50%超过纯流程25%，完整业务恢复未知不足75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 实际Pi/工具与[Q02](#research-q02)worker源码50%，无部署/故障/隔离演练不足75%。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 可固定最小组合/原harness对照25%超过0；存储/沙箱/租户/费用重大未知不足50%。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 托管执行 | claim/heartbeat/harness | 后端合同与业务状态另验 |
| 模型工具 | sandbox.exec等结果回模型 | 权限/默认allow/真实副作用 |
| 确认 | always_ask→pending暂停 | 配置/恢复/接口分别验 |
| 多适配 | 模型/部署/API | 不等所有组合能力一致 |

\n\n# Open Managed Agents\n\n**Any model. Any harness. Any sandbox. Any cloud.**\n\nOpenMA handles sessions, execution and recovery, so you can build and run agents with any model, any harness, any sandbox, on any cloud. An open-source, self-hostable alternative to Claude Managed Agents and OpenAI Agents API.\n\n**Your choice of infrastructure, too.** Use built-in adapters or plug in your own database, queue, and object storage.\n\n[Try hosted](https://app.openma.ai/login) · [Self-host](#self-hosting) · [For agents](#for-agents) · [API examples](#apis-and-compatibility) · [Documentation](https://docs.openma.ai) · [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)\n\n[![OpenMA Console: Agent configuration, integrations, and version history in light mode](docs/assets/console/agent-light.png)](docs/assets/console/agent-light.png)\n\n\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
Model configurationExecution environment
\n\n*Actual Console UI with synthetic demo data. Integration statuses and configurations are illustrative. Click a screenshot to view it at full size.*\n\n## Build on managed execution\n\nCreate an agent, give it work, and return to the same session later. OpenMA provides:\n\n- **Durable sessions and recovery.** Preserve conversation history, stream progress, and coordinate execution attempts without tying the session to one process. Workspace checkpoints and retained outputs support recovery with the configured runtime.\n- **Tools and integrations you can reuse.** Start with shell, file, web, and browser tools. Add MCP services and Skills, then connect agents to the platforms where your team works.\n- **Control over your deployment.** Choose the model, harness, sandbox, and backend services independently. Operate through the Console, CLI, or API.\n\nIf OpenMA is useful to you, give the repository a **Star**. Use **Watch → Custom → Releases** for release notifications.\n\n## For agents\n\nInstall the [deployment skill](skills/deploy-openma/SKILL.md) for your coding agent:\n\n```bash\nnpx skills add openma-ai/open-managed-agents --skill deploy-openma\n```\n\nThen ask: **“Deploy OpenMA on this machine.”** Your agent checks the environment, prepares configuration, deploys the platform, and verifies the Console and an agent task. It asks for the target, login or credentials when needed, and confirms paid cloud resources before creating them. The command installs the guide; deployment starts when you ask your agent.\n\n## Choose your stack\n\n| Layer | Existing integrations and extension points |\n| --- | --- |\n| **Models** | Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and other Pi providers; custom endpoints through [Model Cards](packages/sdk/README.md#pi-backed-model-cards) |\n| **Harnesses** | Built-in Pi; Claude Code, Codex and other agents through [ACP adapters](packages/harness-runtime-acp/README.md); [custom harnesses](#architecture-platform-harness-sandbox) |\n| **Sandboxes** | E2B, Daytona, LiteBox, Cloudflare Sandbox and more; see [provider capabilities](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx) |\n| **Deployment** | Native Node.js, Docker, Fly.io, Vercel (Beta), Cloudflare; [deployment paths](#self-hosting) |\n| **Database** | SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cloudflare D1 and Durable Object SQL adapters; [SQL client and Store interfaces](docs/v1-architecture.md) |\n| **Queue** | SQL-backed queues, Cloudflare Queues and an in-memory adapter; [Queue and dead-letter contracts](packages/queue/src/ports.ts) |\n| **Object storage** | S3-compatible storage, Cloudflare R2, local filesystem and in-memory blob adapters; [BlobStore](packages/blob-store/src/ports.ts) |\n\nUse the included adapters or implement an extension. “Any” means you can extend these interfaces; available features and setup depend on the selected adapters. Follow the linked provider and deployment guides for requirements.\n\n## Architecture: platform, harness, sandbox\n\nOpenMA is a **meta-harness**: it manages the resources and lifecycle around an agent loop. Choose the execution path that fits your agent.\n\n### Harness outside the sandbox: independent lifecycles\n\nRun the model loop outside the sandbox and use the sandbox to execute tools. Keep session history separate from both, so a sandbox failure does not erase the conversation and a replacement harness can rebuild context from durable events. Manage execution resources without coupling them to the lifetime of the agent loop.\n\nUse the built-in Pi harness or implement the [host-side harness interface](apps/agent/src/harness/interface.ts). Workspace restoration depends on the configured persistence and provider; the [Runtime Host guide](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx#session-brain-placement-and-scaling) describes ownership and recovery.\n\n### Harness inside the sandbox: reuse a mature agent\n\nBring Claude Code, Codex, or another established harness into a managed sandbox. Reuse its agent loop, context management, tools, and skills rather than rebuilding those capabilities. OpenMA supplies the surrounding work lifecycle, workspace persistence, and output collection.\n\nThe [ACP runtime](packages/harness-runtime-acp/README.md) provides existing integrations, including versioned harness installation independent of the sandbox image. Custom harnesses can use the [supervisor contract](packages/harness-supervisor/src/index.ts); ACP is one option. Native features and session resume depend on the selected adapter.\n\n## Tools and integrations, already connected\n\n| Capability | What you can use |\n| --- | --- |\n| **Code and files** | Shell execution, file read/write/edit, glob and text search |\n| **Web research** | Web search and page fetching |\n| **Browser automation** | Navigation, clicks, text input, page reading and screenshots; opt in and configure a browser backend |\n| **MCP and Skills** | External tool servers and reusable task instructions; Pi supports deferred tool discovery and on-demand skill loading |\n| **Session resources** | Attach repositories, files, and persistent memory stores with session-scoped access |\n| **Workplace integrations** | GitHub issues and PRs, Linear issues, Slack threads, and Feishu chats |\n\nCombine repository tools with GitHub for issue investigation, or web tools with Slack for a research assistant. Reuse the same tools and skills across more agents instead of building a new integration stack for each workflow. Configure the required service credentials and permissions; in-sandbox harnesses use their native tools and adapter-provided capabilities.\n\n[Built-in tools](apps/agent/src/harness/tools.ts) · [Browser](packages/browser-harness/) · [MCP and Skills](packages/sdk/README.md) · [Integrations](apps/docs/src/content/docs/build/integrations.mdx)\n\n## Scale the execution as your workloads grow\n\nTool reuse helps you add workflows. For more concurrent sessions, Node deployments can use shared PostgreSQL or MySQL and compatible storage/runtime services across replicas. For harnesses outside the sandbox, replicas claim different sessions in parallel through a durable execution outbox, renewable leases, and fencing; work within a session stays ordered. In-sandbox harnesses use the separate Environment Work claim, rather than nesting a second Session execution claim.\n\nThe single-host SQLite quickstart is a separate deployment choice. Capacity depends on the database, storage, sandbox provider, and model limits; see [session execution and scaling](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx#session-brain-placement-and-scaling).\n\n## Complete the work loop with OpenMatter\n\n**Integration status:** [OpenMatter](https://github.com/openma-ai/OpenMatter) implements the Loop runtime. Unified Bond/Loop hosting in this OpenMA revision remains a [proposed integration](docs/adr/0011-matter-bond-and-loop.md).\n\nOpenMatter connects work events to authorized context, agent turns, and recorded results delivered back to the work system. OpenMA supplies the agent execution infrastructure.\n\n```text\nWork event → authorized context → agent execution → result delivery\n ↑ │\n └──────────────── follow-up feedback ────────────────┘\n```\n\nAn issue-to-PR workflow can investigate an issue, prepare a change, post the result, then use review feedback for the next turn. The same pattern can support OpenMA's own development. This is a workflow to compose with application-defined permissions and approvals, not a preconfigured auto-merge bot.\n\n## Support and boundaries\n\n- **API coverage:** Claude Managed Agents and OpenAI Agents API have separate contracts. Both use OpenMA's native infrastructure; the OpenAI adapter's limits do not describe the entire platform. See [API examples and compatibility](#apis-and-compatibility).\n- **Delegation:** Node's OpenAI path supports creating, messaging, waiting on, interrupting, closing, and resuming subagents with independent histories and a shared sandbox. Its execution baseline is single-level delegation; hosted Cloudflare coverage differs. See the [compatibility report](docs/openai-agents-compatibility-status.md).\n- **Credentials:** Model Cards encrypt provider keys at rest. Vault-backed gateways support scoped access to private services; enforced credential isolation depends on the provider and runtime profile. See [credential egress requirements](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx#credential-egress).\n- **Backend extensions:** New adapters must preserve required transaction, claim/retry, and conditional-write semantics. Background queues, Session execution claims, and Environment Work have distinct contracts. The deployment does not fall back to running agent commands in an unisolated host subprocess.\n- Configure the provider's network, storage, and credential-proxy requirements. Remote sandboxes need reachable services; a private Docker hostname alone is not enough.\n- Set `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` for your deployment. Leave authentication enabled. The Compose stack mounts `./data`; keep it when restarting or upgrading. For self-hosting, set `OPENMA_BASE_URL` to your server origin without a trailing slash, such as `http://localhost:8787`.\n\nThe repository pins the official Anthropic SDK to `0.120.0`:\n\n```bash\nnpm install @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.120.0\n```\n\n```ts\nimport Anthropic from \"@anthropic-ai/sdk\";\n\nconst client = new Anthropic({\n apiKey: process.env.OPENMA_API_KEY,\n baseURL: process.env.OPENMA_BASE_URL ?? \"https://app.openma.ai\",\n});\n\nconst agent = await client.beta.agents.create({\n name: \"researcher\",\n model: process.env.OPENMA_MODEL_ID!,\n system: \"Help me investigate a task and explain your findings.\",\n});\n\nconst session = await client.beta.sessions.create({\n agent: { type: \"agent\", id: agent.id, version: agent.version },\n environment_id: process.env.OPENMA_ENVIRONMENT_ID!,\n});\n\nawait client.beta.sessions.events.send(session.id, {\n events: [{\n type: \"user.message\",\n content: [{ type: \"text\", text: \"Help me plan a code review.\" }],\n }],\n});\n\nconsole.log(session.id);\n```\n\nOpen that session in the Console to follow the task. For typed OpenMA extensions, use [`@openma/sdk`](packages/sdk/README.md), which composes the official Anthropic SDK.\n\n### OpenAI Agents API quickstart\n\nUse the same OpenMA API key and a configured Model Card. \n\n# Open Managed Agents\n\n**Any model. Any harness. Any sandbox. Any cloud.**\n\nOpenMA 管理会话、执行与恢复，让你自由选择模型、harness、沙箱和部署平台，构建并运行自己的 Agent。它是 Claude Managed Agents 和 OpenAI Agents API 的开源、可自部署替代方案。\n\n**底层基础设施，也由你选择。** 使用现成适配器，或接入你自己的数据库、队列和对象存储。\n\n[托管试用](https://app.openma.ai/login) · [自部署](#自部署) · [For agents](#for-agents) · [API 示例](#api-与兼容范围) · [文档](https://docs.openma.ai) · [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) · [English](README.md)\n\n[![OpenMA Console 亮色 Agent 配置、集成与版本历史界面](docs/assets/console/agent-light.png)](docs/assets/console/agent-light.png)\n\n\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
模型配置执行环境
\n\n*真实 Console 界面，使用合成演示数据；集成状态和配置仅供展示。点击截图可查看原图。*\n\n## 在托管执行基础上构建 Agent\n\n创建 Agent、交给它任务，之后回到同一个会话继续工作。OpenMA 提供：\n\n- **持久会话与恢复。** 保存对话历史、展示流式进展、协调执行，不把会话绑在一个进程上。配置好相应运行时后，可使用工作区检查点与保留产物支持恢复。\n- **可复用的工具与集成。** 从 Shell、文件、网页、浏览器工具开始，接入 MCP 和 Skills，再把 Agent 连接到团队日常使用的工作平台。\n- **部署选择权。** 模型、harness、沙箱和后端服务可以独立选择，通过 Console、CLI 或 API 操作。\n\n如果 OpenMA 对你有帮助，欢迎给仓库点 **Star**。发版通知可通过 **Watch → Custom → Releases** 订阅。\n\n## For agents\n\n给你的 coding agent 安装 [OpenMA 部署 Skill](skills/deploy-openma/SKILL.md)：\n\n```bash\nnpx skills add openma-ai/open-managed-agents --skill deploy-openma\n```\n\n然后告诉它：**“帮我在这台机器上部署 OpenMA。”** Agent 会检查环境、准备配置、执行部署，并验证 Console 和 Agent 任务；需要你选择目标、登录或提供凭证时再询问，创建付费云资源前会确认。这条命令安装部署指南，实际部署由你随后交给 Agent 执行。\n\n## 选择你的技术栈\n\n| 层次 | 现有集成与扩展入口 |\n| --- | --- |\n| **模型** | Anthropic、OpenAI、DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等 Pi provider；通过 [Model Card](packages/sdk/README.md#pi-backed-model-cards) 配置自定义端点 |\n| **Harness** | 内置 Pi；通过 [ACP 适配](packages/harness-runtime-acp/README.md) 接入 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent；[自定义 harness](#架构平台harness-与沙箱) |\n| **沙箱** | E2B、Daytona、LiteBox、Cloudflare Sandbox 等；详见[供应商能力](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx) |\n| **部署** | 原生 Node.js、Docker、Fly.io、Vercel（Beta）、Cloudflare；[部署入口](#自部署) |\n| **数据库** | SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Cloudflare D1、Durable Object SQL 适配器；[SQL client 与 Store 接口](docs/v1-architecture.md) |\n| **队列** | SQL 持久队列、Cloudflare Queues、内存适配器；[Queue 与死信合同](packages/queue/src/ports.ts) |\n| **对象存储** | S3 兼容存储、Cloudflare R2、本地文件系统及内存 Blob 适配器；[BlobStore](packages/blob-store/src/ports.ts) |\n\n使用现成适配器，或实现自己的扩展。Any 表示接口可扩展，具体功能和配置取决于所选适配器；要求见表中的供应商与部署指南。\n\n## 架构：平台、harness 与沙箱\n\nOpenMA 采用 **meta-harness** 架构，管理 Agent loop 周围的资源和生命周期。根据 Agent 的需要选择执行路径。\n\n### Harness 在沙箱外：独立管理生命周期\n\n模型循环在沙箱外运行，沙箱负责工具执行，会话历史独立于两者保存。沙箱故障不会抹掉对话，替换后的 harness 可以从持久事件重建上下文。执行资源的生命周期与 Agent loop 解耦。\n\n使用内置 Pi，或实现[宿主侧 harness 接口](apps/agent/src/harness/interface.ts)。工作区恢复需要对应的持久化配置和供应商支持；[Runtime Host 指南](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx#session-brain-placement-and-scaling) 说明了执行归属与恢复机制。\n\n### Harness 在沙箱内：复用成熟 Agent\n\n将 Claude Code、Codex 等已有 harness 放进托管沙箱，复用它的 Agent loop、上下文管理、工具和技能，无需重新实现这些能力。OpenMA 提供外层的工作生命周期、工作区持久化和产物收集。\n\n[ACP runtime](packages/harness-runtime-acp/README.md) 提供现成接入，支持将版本化 harness 安装与沙箱镜像分开管理。自定义 harness 可使用 [supervisor 合同](packages/harness-supervisor/src/index.ts)，ACP 只是其中一种选项。原生功能与会话续接范围取决于所选适配器。\n\n## 已集成的工具，更少的接入工作\n\n| 能力 | 可以使用什么 |\n| --- | --- |\n| **代码与文件** | Shell 执行、文件读写与编辑、文件匹配和文本搜索 |\n| **网页研究** | Web 搜索与页面抓取 |\n| **浏览器自动化** | 导航、点击、输入、读取页面、截图；需显式启用并配置浏览器后端 |\n| **MCP 与 Skills** | 外部工具服务和可复用指令；Pi 支持按需发现工具、加载技能 |\n| **会话资源** | 关联仓库、文件和持久化 Memory Store，按会话授权访问 |\n| **工作平台** | GitHub issue/PR、Linear issue、Slack 线程和飞书会话 |\n\n将仓库工具与 GitHub 组合用于 issue 调查，或将网页工具与 Slack 组合成研究助手。把同一套工具和技能复用到更多 Agent，减少为每个工作流重新接入服务的成本。凭证和权限按要求配置；沙箱内 harness 使用自身工具及适配器提供的能力。\n\n[内置工具](apps/agent/src/harness/tools.ts) · [浏览器](packages/browser-harness/) · [MCP 与 Skills](packages/sdk/README.md) · [集成](apps/docs/src/content/docs/build/integrations.mdx)\n\n## 随工作量扩展执行规模\n\n工具复用帮助你扩展业务场景。需要并行处理更多会话时，Node 部署可在多个实例间使用共享 PostgreSQL 或 MySQL，以及配套存储和运行时服务。Harness 在沙箱外时，多个实例通过持久执行 outbox、可续约租约和 fencing 并行领取不同 Session，同一 Session 内的工作保持顺序。沙箱内 harness 使用独立的 Environment Work 领取机制，不叠加第二层 Session 执行领取。\n\nSQLite 快速开始面向单机，是另一种部署选择。实际容量取决于数据库、存储、沙箱供应商和模型限制；详见[会话执行与扩展](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx#session-brain-placement-and-scaling)。\n\n## 通过 OpenMatter，让工作形成闭环\n\n**接入状态：** [OpenMatter](https://github.com/openma-ai/OpenMatter) 已实现 Loop runtime；当前这份 OpenMA 中的统一 Bond/Loop 托管仍处于[接入提案](docs/adr/0011-matter-bond-and-loop.md)阶段。\n\nOpenMatter 将工作事件、授权上下文、Agent 执行和结果回写串起来；OpenMA 提供 Agent 执行基础设施。\n\n```text\n工作事件 → 授权上下文 → Agent 执行 → 结果回写\n ↑ │\n └──────────── 后续反馈 ──────────────┘\n```\n\n一条 issue-to-PR 工作流可以调查 issue、准备修改、回写结果，再根据 review 反馈进入下一轮。同样的模式也能用于 OpenMA 自身的开发。这是按应用权限和审批要求组合的工作流，不是预装的自动合并机器人。\n\n## 支持范围\n\n- **API 覆盖：** Claude Managed Agents 和 OpenAI Agents API 各有合同，都使用 OpenMA 原生基础设施。OpenAI 适配器的限制不代表整个平台的能力范围。参见 [API 示例与兼容范围](#api-与兼容范围)。\n- **子任务委派：** Node 的 OpenAI 路径支持创建、发消息、等待、中断、关闭和恢复子代理；子代理有独立历史并共享沙箱。执行基线为单层委派，托管 Cloudflare 覆盖不同。参见[兼容性报告](docs/openai-agents-compatibility-status.md)。\n- **凭证：** Model Card 加密存储模型凭证，Vault 网关提供限定范围的私有服务访问。强制凭证隔离取决于供应商和运行时配置，参见[凭证出口要求](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/managed-runtime-host.mdx#credential-egress)。\n- **后端扩展：** 新适配器需满足事务、任务领取与重试、条件写入等语义。后台队列、Session 执行领取和 Environment Work 各有合同。参见 [Node 组装](apps/main-node/src/components.ts) 和[架构](docs/v1-architecture.md)。\n\n\n\n## 自部署\n\n| 部署方式 | 入口 | 说明 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **原生 Node.js / Docker** | [快速开始](#quick-start-docker) · [Node 指南](https://docs.openma.ai/self-host/node-docker/) | 配置隔离执行环境与持久化存储 |\n| **Fly.io** | [Fly 指南](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/fly.mdx) | Node 控制面，使用固定版本的服务镜像 |\n| **Vercel（Beta）** | [配置器](https://openma.ai/deploy/) · [适配器](apps/main-vercel/) | 单独配置数据库、对象存储和沙箱，受 serverless 运行边界约束 |\n| **Cloudflare** | [配置向导](#快速开始cloudflare-部署) | 在你的账号中创建资源 |\n\n\n\n\n\n### Node / Docker\n\n让 coding agent 使用[部署 Skill](#for-agents)完成配置与启动，或展开下面的手工步骤。\n\n
\n手工部署 Docker\n\n安装 Docker 和 Compose，然后执行：\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/openma-ai/open-managed-agents.git\ncd open-managed-agents\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\n启动前编辑 `.env`：\n\n- 用 `openssl rand -hex 32` 生成 `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`，用 `openssl rand -base64 32` 生成 `PLATFORM_ROOT_SECRET`。安全保管两者，并随数据备份加密根密钥。\n- 选择隔离的 `SANDBOX_PROVIDER` 并提供其配置。部署入口不会退回到非隔离的宿主机子进程执行 Agent 命令。\n- 配置该供应商的网络、存储和凭证代理。远程沙箱必须能访问所需服务，仅有 Docker 内网主机名并不够。\n- 设置部署的 `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`，保持认证开启。在 Console 中添加 Model Card，或使用文档说明的环境变量回退方式配置模型。\n\n```bash\ndocker compose up -d --build\ncurl --fail http://localhost:8787/health\n```\n\n打开 `http://localhost:8787` 创建账号，然后配置模型与环境。Compose 将 `./data` 挂载到容器，重启和升级时保留它。`/health` 成功只说明服务就绪，不代表已经成功运行模型或沙箱任务。\n\n对外开放服务前，请阅读 [Node 部署指南](https://docs.openma.ai/self-host/node-docker/)、[环境变量模板](.env.example) 和 [Compose 配置](docker-compose.yml)。\n\n
\n\n### 快速开始：Cloudflare 部署\n\n使用 [`.node-version`](.node-version) 指定的 Node、仓库固定的 pnpm，以及构建容器所需的 Docker、`jq` 和 `openssl`。登录已启用所需 Workers/Containers 服务的 Cloudflare 账号。\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/openma-ai/open-managed-agents.git\ncd open-managed-agents\npnpm install --frozen-lockfile\nnpx wrangler login\npnpm setup:cloudflare\n```\n\n脚本创建 Cloudflare 资源、更新本地 Wrangler 配置、设置密钥并部署 Workers。若环境变量未提供 Anthropic API key，当前脚本会提示输入。运行前请查看 [`scripts/setup-cf.sh`](scripts/setup-cf.sh) 和[部署指南](apps/docs/src/content/docs/self-host/deploy.mdx)；这会创建云资源并可能产生费用。使用自己的部署所打印的地址，而不是 OpenMA 托管域名。\n\n## API 与兼容范围\n\n| 接口 | 用途 | 参考 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **Claude Managed Agents**，`/v1/*` | 通过官方 Anthropic SDK 操作 Agent、环境、会话、事件和 Worker 合同 | [合同测试](packages/managed-agents-api/) · [SDK E2E](test/e2e/managed-agents-sdk.mjs) |\n| **OpenAI Agents API**，`/openai/v1/*` | 将 OpenAI SDK 调用映射到 OpenMA 原生 Agent、会话和执行 | [适配器](packages/openai-agents-compat/README.md) · [兼容性报告](docs/openai-agents-compatibility-status.md) |\n| **OpenMA 扩展**，`/v1/oma/*` | Model Card 等产品功能 | [OpenMA SDK](packages/sdk/README.md) |\n\nOpenMA 是独立实现，迁移前请核对 API 和运行时覆盖。\n\n### Claude Managed Agents API\n\n先在 Console 创建 OpenMA API key、Model Card 和环境，设置 `OPENMA_API_KEY`、`OPENMA_MODEL_ID`（Model Card 的 `model_id`，不是数据库记录 ID）及 `OPENMA_ENVIRONMENT_ID`。自部署时，将 `OPENMA_BASE_URL` 设为自己的服务地址，不带结尾斜杠，例如 `http://localhost:8787`。\n\n仓库固定的官方 Anthropic SDK 版本为 `0.120.0`：\n\n```bash\nnpm install @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.120.0\n```\n\n```ts\nimport Anthropic from \"@anthropic-ai/sdk\";\n\nconst client = new Anthropic({\n apiKey: process.env.OPENMA_API_KEY,\n baseURL: process.env.OPENMA_BASE_URL ?? \"https://app.openma.ai\",\n});\n\nconst agent = await client.beta.agents.create({\n name: \"researcher\",\n model: process.env.OPENMA_MODEL_ID!,\n system: \"Help me investigate a task and explain your findings.\",\n});\n\nconst session = await client.beta.sessions.create({\n agent: { type: \"agent\", id: agent.id, version: agent.version },\n environment_id: process.env.OPENMA_ENVIRONMENT_ID!,\n});\n\nawait client.beta.sessions.events.send(session.id, {\n events: [{\n type: \"user.message\",\n content: [{ type: \"text\", text: \"Help me plan a code review.\" }],\n }],\n});\n\nconsole.log(session.id);\n```\n\n在 Console 中打开返回的会话查看任务进展。[官方 SDK E2E](test/e2e/managed-agents-sdk.mjs) 还演示了事件流和会话续接。需要带类型的 OpenMA 扩展时，可使用组合了官方 Anthropic SDK 的 [`@openma/sdk`](packages/sdk/README.md)。\n\n### OpenAI Agents API 快速开始\n\n使用同一个 OpenMA API key 和已配置的 Model Card。此适配器的 SDK 测试基线为 `openai@7.15.0`：\n\n```bash\nnpm install openai@7.15.0\n```\n\n```ts\nimport OpenAI from \"openai\";\n\nconst client = new OpenAI({\n apiKey: process.env.OPENMA_API_KEY,\n baseURL: `${process.env.OPENMA_BASE_URL ?? \"https://app.openma.ai\"}/openai/v1`,\n});\n\nconst events = await client.beta.agents.sessions.create({\n agent: {\n model: process.env.OPENMA_MODEL_ID!,\n instructions: \"Help me investigate a task and explain your findings.\",\n },\n environment: { type: \"none\" },\n input: \"Help me plan a code review.\",\n stream: true,\n});\n\nfor await (const event of events) console.log(event);\n```\n\n示例不申请沙箱，Node 和托管 Cloudflare 均支持这条会话路径。OpenAI 动态子代理控制目前需要 Node，采用单层委派；高级环境、插件和部分模型/工具设置还有额外限制。这些是适配器的边界，不代表整个平台缺少对应能力。详见[兼容性报告](docs/openai-agents-compatibility-status.md)。\n\n## 开发与社区\n\n使用 [`.node-version`](.node-version) 和 [`package.json`](package.json)
